findings.title: Retirement ownership uses mutable non-global group name
findings.evidence: Selection restricts g.name=module-relation-writers but not immutable owned group/account identity; timestamp is set unconditionally at line289 even when selection found none. Group.Update supports name (internal/apps/kaname/api/group/update.go:32,99-101), so renaming the historical group leaves its active blanket binding behind while retirement is recorded complete. The new guard repeats name-based selection, so that binding is not fenced. groups_account_name_unique at 0001_initial.sql:4137 scopes names to account: a same-named group in another account can instead be selected/revoked or blocked. The trigger also omits the singleton resource_id restriction used by retirement.
findings.fix: Resolve and persist the exact installation-owned immutable legacy group/binding identity and canonical cluster coordinate; use the same identity predicate for selection, locked-row ownership recheck and retirement guard. Prove rename still retires the owned binding and an unrelated same-name group remains unchanged; do not weaken general validators or restore blanket grants.
